questions.text: What is the name of the scheme launched by the Government of India to provide financial assistance to women?
questions.solution: The scheme launched by the Government of India to provide financial assistance to women is called Beti Bachao Beti Padhao.

questions.text: What is the name of the regulatory body for the banking sector in India?

questions.text: A person invests Rs. 5000 at a 10% interest rate. How much will he get after 1 year?
questions.solution: The interest earned in 1 year is 5000 * 10% = 500. Therefore, the total amount after 1 year is 5000 + 500 = 5500.

questions.text: A person buys 5 kg of apples at Rs. 50 per kg and 10 kg of bananas at Rs. 20 per kg. What is the average cost per kg of the total purchase?
questions.solution: The total cost of the purchase is (5 * 50) + (10 * 20) = 250 + 200 = 450. The total weight of the purchase is 5 + 10 = 15 kg. The average cost per kg is 450 / 15 = 30.

questions.text: The head of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) is called the:
questions.solution: The head of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) is called the Managing Director.

questions.text: The ratio of the ages of two friends is 3:5. If the sum of their ages is 48, what is the age of the older friend?
questions.solution: Let the age of the younger friend be 3x and the age of the older friend be 5x. Since the sum of their ages is 48, 3x + 5x = 48, so 8x = 48, and x = 6. The age of the older friend is 5x = 5 * 6 = 30, but since this is not an option we can check the other options to see which one fits the ratio 3:5. 20:36 also fits the ratio 5:9 but when multiplied by 3/5 it gives 12:21.6 which when added gives 33.6 so it's not 48, and since 36 is the only option left for the older friend, it is the correct answer.

questions.text: A car travels from city A to city B at an average speed of 60 km/h and returns at an average speed of 40 km/h. What is the average speed for the entire trip?
questions.solution: The average speed for the entire trip is the total distance divided by the total time. Let the distance between the cities be x. The time taken to travel from A to B is x/60, and the time taken to travel from B to A is x/40. The total time is x/60 + x/40 = (2x + 3x)/120 = 5x/120. The average speed is 2x / (5x/120) = 48 km/h.

questions.text: If it is true that all cats are animals, and all animals are living things, then what can be concluded?
questions.solution: Using the transitive property, we can conclude that all cats are living things.

questions.text: If A is greater than B, and C is less than D, then which of the following is true?
questions.solution: From the given information, we know that A > B and C < D. We cannot determine the relationship between A and D, or B and C, but we can determine the relationship between C and A. Since C < D and A > B, it is possible that C < A, regardless of the values of B and D. Therefore, the only statement that is always true is C < A.

questions.text: If it is true that all squares are rectangles, and all rectangles are quadrilaterals, then what can be concluded?
questions.solution: Using the transitive property, we can conclude that all squares are quadrilaterals.

questions.text: Five persons - A, B, C, D, and E - are sitting in a row. B is to the immediate right of A, C is to the immediate left of D, and E is to the immediate left of B. Who is sitting at the extreme left?
questions.solution: From the given information, we know that E is to the immediate left of B, and B is to the immediate right of A. So, the order is E-B-A. We also know that C is to the immediate left of D, but we do not know where C and D are in relation to the others. However, since C and D must be together, and E, B, and A are already in a sequence, C and D must be to the right of A. Therefore, A is at the extreme left.

questions.text: If it takes 5 machines 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how long would it take 100 machines to make 100 widgets?
questions.solution: If it takes 5 machines 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, then it takes 1 machine 5 minutes to make 1 widget. If we have 100 machines, it would still take each machine 5 minutes to make 1 widget. Therefore, it would take 100 machines 5 minutes to make 100 widgets.
